name: 9V 1A DC Power Supply Adapter
description: Regulated wall adapter converting 100-240V AC to 9V 1000mA DC with standard 5.5mm x 2.1mm center-positive barrel jack.
realWorldAnalogy: Regulated wall adapter converting 100-240V AC to 9V 1000mA DC with standard 5.5mm x 2.1mm center-positive barrel jack.

hazards: Use wall outlets under adult supervision
Do not cut or short power cord wires
safety.childSafeAlternative: Use USB cable power or 9V battery snap connector for portable power

wiringGuidance: Plug directly into the Arduino Uno or Mega circular black barrel jack. The board's onboard voltage regulator will cleanly step down 9V to 5V and 3.3V.
commonMistakes: Plugging an AC-output adapter or reverse-polarity supply into the Arduino (GAR adapter is verified center-positive DC).
Leaving power supply plugged into wall when not in use.

miniExperiment.title: Untethered Robot Power Up
miniExperiment.circuit: Unplug USB cable. Plug 9V DC adapter barrel jack into Arduino Uno DC socket. Plug adapter into wall.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: The Arduino boots autonomously without computer connection, and the LED blinks untethered.
